data.name: Govinda
data.long_meaning: Govinda is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'go' meaning 'cow' and 'vinda' meaning 'one who attracts'. This name is associated with Lord Krishna, who is believed to have attracted the hearts of all beings towards him. Therefore, Govinda signifies 'God's companion' or 'one who serves God'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Serving and connecting with the divine.

in_sanskrit.name: गोविन्द
in_sanskrit.meaning: God who delights in the world
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
गो (go) - Cow, wealth, prosperity, abundance, material world
विन्द (vind) - To please, to find, to enjoy, to delight

in_hindi.name: गोविंद
in_hindi.meaning:
गो (go) - गाय (gāy) - Cow
विंद (vind) - प्रसन्न (prasann) - Delighted, pleased, contented, calm
Therefore, 'Govinda' can be translated as 'He who delights in the world (cow)'

in_tamil.name: கோவிந்த
in_tamil.meaning:
கோ (kō) - Cow, wealth, prosperity, abundance
விந்த (vind) - To find, to enjoy, to delight
in_tamil.long_meaning:
கோ (kō) - ஜீர்கள் (jīrkāl) - Cow
விந்த (vind) - உடன்தொடர் (udan todar) - To find, to search, to pursue
அல்லவோ (allavo) - Or
இல்லையோ (illaiyō) - Not
Therefore, 'Govinda' in Tamil can be translated as 'He who finds or searches for the cow, wealth, prosperity, abundance, or not finds it'

vedic_reference.note: Govinda is a name of Lord Krishna. He is described as 'Ananda-mohana Hari', the one who delights in the world. He is also known as 'Pushti-Dhama-Mahatma', the one who provides nourishment and sustenance to the entire universe. Govinda is also the name of Lord Vishnu and Shiva.

data.cultural_impact: The name Govinda holds a significant place in Hindu culture. It is chanted frequently in the 'Saltagovinda' Ashtakam prayer, which is a part of the Bhagavad Purana, and is recited to invoke the blessings of Lord Krishna. It is also the name of a popular deity in the Vaishnavite tradition and is often depicted alongside Lord Krishna or used as a synonym for the Lord himself. The name Govinda is a reminder of the divine connection between humans and the supreme deity, emphasizing the devotional aspect of Hinduism.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Govinda lies in its association with Lord Krishna, the embodiment of love and divine grace. The name signifies the idea that by serving God, one can experience true joy and fulfillment in life. Govinda also represents the divine power that attracts all beings towards the deity, demonstrating the love and compassion of the universe. Chanting or meditating on this name can help one connect with the inner spiritual Self and experience a sense of peace and surrender.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Govinda is a name of Krishna in Hinduism. The name Govinda carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Govinda is a popular name for Krishna in Bhakti movement.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Govinda remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
